chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Muawiya ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
When you direct yourself to Mina, say: 'O Allah, to You I hope and to You I supplicate, so grant me the fulfillment of my desire and rectify my deed for me.'

key_terms.أَصْلِحْ لِي عَمَلِي: Rectify my deed, asking God to make one's actions acceptable and correct
key_terms.أَمَلِي: My hope/desire, referring to the pilgrim's spiritual or worldly aspirations
key_terms.مِنًى: Mina, a sacred site near Mecca where pilgrims spend days of Hajj

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication to recite when traveling to Mina for Hajj?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this supplication highlights the spiritual transition from the city to the plain of Mina, where the pilgrim seeks divine acceptance (qabul) and the rectification of deeds (islah al-'amal). It reflects the Shia emphasis on combining hope in God's mercy with the practical need for righteous action, serving as a preparatory invocation for the rituals of the second day of Dhu al-Hijjah.
